name: Everand
verdict_reason: Everand is a catalog subscription — the books aren't yours either way. Kavita beautifully serves media you own (and we verified it boots), but it cannot conjure Everand's library. Third member of the catalog-is-the-product pattern, after Spotify and Audible.
what_you_lose: Nothing — if you own your ebooks, run Kavita for them regardless; it just doesn't replace the subscription

what_broke: Boot to healthy measured at 32s on the 2GB reference env
